# Apes
[bold]Apes[/bold] are dangerous megafauna found on some frontier worlds: huge, powerful primates with an enormous appetite. Where they live, colonists learn quickly to stay out of the wilds after dark.
- Their [bold]caloric needs[/bold] are immense, and a hungry ape will hunt anything it can catch, people included. - They are frighteningly tough. An ape can shrug off wounds that would kill a person several times over, and keep coming. - They see well in the dark, and have strength enough to tear a limb from a body. - They are smarter than they look. Reports from colonies under attack describe apes striking together, in numbers, at supply lines and other soft targets.
